title: Action may be required: Developer Portal username and password sign-in turned off
summary: On November 22, 2026, as part of a latest platform update, Microsoft turned off username and password sign-in to the Azure API Management Developer Portal due to inactivity. On those instances, developers can't sign in or sign up with a username and password. API traffic isn't affected.
description_problem: On November 22, 2026, as part of a latest platform update, Microsoft turned off username and password sign-in to the Azure API Management Developer Portal due to inactivity. On those instances, developers can't sign in or sign up with a username and password. API traffic isn't affected. What you need to do: Recommended: set up Microsoft Entra ID for Developer Portal sign-in. Secure access to developer portal - Azure API Management | Microsoft Learn (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/api-management/secure-developer-portal-access) To turn username and password sign-in back on: in the Azure portal, open your API Management instance and go to Developer portal > Identities > + Add > Username and password. Set up Basic Authentication to the Developer Portal - Azure API Management | Microsoft Learn (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/api-management/developer-portal-basic-authentication) Help and Support If you have questions, get answers from community experts in Microsoft Q&A (https://learn.microsoft.com/answers/tags/133/azure). If you have a support plan and need technical help, please create a support request (https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-portal/supportability/how-to-create-azure-support-request).
